svg.aria-label: Identity in Postgres, gates at the gateway: 1. Database: authentik-db creates the role and database authentik on the shared CloudNativePG cluster before the app starts. 2. Secrets: ExternalSecret authentik-secret merges three 1Password items into one Secret, and Reloader restarts the pods when it changes. 3. Serve: The server and worker run flows and sessions. Sessions live in Postgres, cache sits on Dragonfly, and media goes to a Ceph bucket. 4. Gate: The embedded outpost answers Envoy ExtAuth checks under /outpost.goauthentik.io, so an outage fails every gated app closed.
